description: Create an event from a natural-language description using AI (resolves calendar names, unlike calendar_create which needs an EventKit ID). Reports scheduling conflicts unless allowConflicts is set.

allowConflicts.description: Create even if it overlaps an existing event.

confirmToken.description: Only after a confirmation_required error: the confirmToken it returned, with the same arguments, to carry out the call.

description.description: Natural-language event description, e.g. 'lunch with Sam next Tuesday at noon'.

dryRun.description: Show the parsed event without creating it.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A repeat of this key with the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result with replayed=true and does nothing.

provider.description: AI provider: ollama, claude, or openai.

title: calendar_smart_create: arguments
